data.title: Cambodia faces fresh scrutiny over scam compounds despite crackdown - The Cambodia Daily
data.description: Cambodia is facing renewed questions about its campaign against online fraud after an Al Jazeera investigation alleged that a coastal resort continued to harbour scam operations and human trafficking.

data.title: UNICEF warns El Niño could put 1.3 million Cambodian children at risk - The Cambodia Daily
data.description: About 1.3 million children in Cambodia could face extreme weather linked to El Niño from late 2026 into 2027, according to a UNICEF warning reported by China’s Xinhua news agency.

data.title: Returning Cambodian workers could boost economy while families lose income - The Cambodia Daily
data.description: The return of hundreds of thousands of Cambodian workers from Thailand could increase Cambodia’s economic output while leaving individual households worse off, according to research by the Cambodia Development Resource Institute.

data.title: Human Rights Watch urges Vietnam to free activists who disappeared in Cambodia - The Cambodia Daily
data.description: Human Rights Watch has called on Vietnam to unconditionally release three democracy activists who disappeared in Cambodia before being detained by Vietnamese authorities.

data.title: Cambodia faces scrutiny over border dispute and online scam crackdown - The Cambodia Daily
data.description: Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Manet has accused Thai forces of opening fire first in a border confrontation, as both sides trade blame over the fighting.

data.title: China’s military ties with Laos draw scrutiny over upgraded airfield - The Cambodia Daily
data.description: China has refurbished a military airfield in Laos, raising questions about Beijing’s growing security presence in Southeast Asia.

data.title: Cambodian unions criticise $2 rise in garment workers’ minimum wage - The Cambodia Daily
data.description: Cambodian unions and civil society groups have criticised a decision to set the minimum wage for garment workers and related sectors at $210 a month in 2027, saying the $2 increase will fail to keep pace with rising living costs.

data.title: Cambodia denies role in disappearance of two activists held in Vietnam - The Cambodia Daily
data.description: Cambodia has denied allegations that its authorities detained two democracy activists and helped transfer them to Vietnam after they disappeared during a visit to Cambodia.

data.title: Cambodia Says 90,000 Jobs Are Available Nationwide - The Cambodia Daily
data.description: Cambodia’s Ministry of Labour and Vocational Training says about 90,000 jobs are currently available across the country, with employers seeking workers in agriculture, industry and services.

data.title: Khmer Analysts Divided Over Appointment of Kem Sokha’s Daughter as Special Envoy to Prime Minister Hun Manet - The Cambodia Daily
data.description: The appointment of Kem Monovithya, daughter of Kem Sokha, as a special envoy to Prime Minister Hun Manet has drawn differing assessments from Cambodian analysts. Some view the appointment as an opportunity for her to contribute to society, while others see deeper political implications behind the move.

data.title: Cambodia and Vietnam Strengthen Defence and Public Security Cooperation - The Cambodia Daily
data.description: Cambodia and Vietnam have pledged to deepen cooperation in defence and public security, as Phnom Penh seeks to strengthen ties with Hanoi amid continuing tensions in its relationship with Thailand.

data.title: ASEAN Observers Inspect Disputed Cambodia-Thailand Border Area - The Cambodia Daily
data.description: An ASEAN observer team has inspected a disputed area along the Cambodia-Thailand border, as Cambodia reaffirmed its commitment to resolving the dispute peacefully through negotiations, bilateral mechanisms and international law.

data.title: Cambodia says ceasefire cannot create new border with Thailand. - The Cambodia Daily
data.description: Cambodia's Information Minister says the ceasefire with Thailand cannot be used to establish a new international border or give legal ownership of disputed territory.

data.title: Cambodia to suspend online gambling at all casinos from October  - The Cambodia Daily
data.description: Cambodia will suspend online gambling operations at all casinos across the country from October 2026 as part of government efforts to strengthen measures against technology-related scams and the circulation of money from unclear sources.

data.title: Cambodia Closes 600 Scam Centres, Sends 4,000 Suspects to Court - The Cambodia Daily
data.description: Cambodian authorities have continued operations targeting technology-enabled fraud, commonly known as online scams, identifying and shutting down 605 criminal sites and referring 4,147 suspects to the Phnom Penh Municipal Court.

data.description: The mother of former monk Chea Vuthy has called on the court to release her son, describing the charge of incitement against him as unjust and unacceptable. data.description: Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Manet has set Sunday, June 6, 2027, as the date for the country’s sixth commune and sangkat council elections, a key local vote seen as an important test of political support ahead of national elections.
